from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from llm_router import Model, Provider
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import normalize_content
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.tools import ToolRegistry
from llm_router._internal.providers.base import (
    ProviderCredential,
    ProviderRequest,
)
from llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat import QwenChatAdapter

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


def _request(
    *,
    messages: list[Any],
    temperature: float | None = None,
    seed: int | None = None,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry | None = None,
    tool_choice: Any = None,
    kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> ProviderRequest:
    value = "test-credential"
    return ProviderRequest(
        provider=Provider.QWENCHAT,
        model=Model.QWEN_MAX,
        provider_model="qwen-max",
        messages=messages,
        credential=ProviderCredential(value),
        temperature=temperature,
        seed=seed,
        tool_registry=tool_registry,
        tool_choice=tool_choice,
        kwargs=kwargs or {},
    )


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
async def test_qwenchat_abuild_payload_preserves_parameters() -> None:
    image = Image.new("RGB", (10, 10), color="white")
    uploaded_ref = "https://proxy.test/files/upload-123.png"

    async def stub_uploader(media: Any) -> str:
        assert media is image
        return uploaded_ref

    def lookup_weather(location: str) -> str:
        """Look up the weather for a given city."""
        return f"Weather in {location}"

    tool_registry = ToolRegistry()
    tool_registry.register(lookup_weather)

    request = _request(
        messages=[normalize_content(["Describe this image.", image])],
        temperature=0.7,
        seed=42,
        tool_registry=tool_registry,
        tool_choice="auto",
        kwargs={"top_p": 0.8},
    )

    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:1/api")
    payload = await adapter.abuild_payload(request, uploader=stub_uploader)

    assert payload["model"] == "qwen-max"
    assert payload["stream"] is False
    assert payload["temperature"] == 0.7
    assert payload["seed"] == 42
    assert payload["tool_choice"] == "auto"
    assert payload["top_p"] == 0.8
    assert payload["tools"] == [
        dict(definition.descriptor)
        for definition in tool_registry.tools.values()
    ]
    assert uploaded_ref in json.dumps(payload["messages"])
